notes: Local closed-loop kinematic FullVA stepper for the fully constrained ASME four_link and slider_crank graphs. At each output time it solves Phi(q,t)=0 by Newton, projects rotations onto SO(3), then solves Phi_q qdot=nu and Phi_q qdd=gamma. Because these two ASME examples are driven kinematic closed loops with nc=6*nb, the h-sweep is a nested sampling/reproducibility check rather than a dynamic integration order claim.
